title: Add new stable version 2026-06-01 for New Relic

artifactEvidence.autorest: Cached base/head compilation succeeded. Head adds the complete stable 2026-06-01 OpenAPI surface; comparison with the prior preview shows no incompatible wire-contract changes.
artifactEvidence.tcgc: Cached base/head compilation succeeded. The generic client surface adds 2026-06-01 and changes every client API-version default from 2025-05-01-preview to 2026-06-01; the Go-only override is verified from changed TypeSpec source.

items.intent: Add a stable API version and reorder Go delete parameters
transformationChain: The service becomes explicitly versioned with 2025-05-01-preview and 2026-06-01, exposing the existing operations in the stable version. A client.tsp @@override places userEmail before monitorName in the generated Go delete signature while preserving query and path serialization.

changes.summary: Add a stable API version and reorder Go delete parameters

aspects.before: The stable version was absent and Go used the default delete parameter order.
aspects.after: The API is available as 2026-06-01 and Go places userEmail before monitorName.

changes.effect: The service becomes explicitly versioned with 2025-05-01-preview and 2026-06-01, exposing the existing operations in the stable version. A client.tsp @@override places userEmail before monitorName in the generated Go delete signature while preserving query and path serialization.
